{{Top|leg}}
'''Temporary consulting committees''' were created at the discretion of the [[ExO]] and after consultation with the [[Executive Directorship Board]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] from outside contractors and advisers. The committees usually lasted for around two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], but some had been in existence for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]. The committees were tasked with examining potential plans and projects and determining costs, benefits and drawbacks.
